focus_1.title: La ilaha illAllah (Declaration of Faith)
focus_1.translation: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah.
focus_1.benefit: The best dhikr — the most beloved statement to Allah. SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, La ilaha illAllah, Allahu Akbar.

focus_2.title: SubhanAllahi wa Bihamdihi
focus_2.translation: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him.
focus_2.benefit: Sins forgiven even if they are like sea foam. Fills the scales of good deeds.

focus_3.title: Astaghfirullah (Seeking Forgiveness)
focus_3.translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah and turn to Him in repentance.
focus_3.benefit: Through this, sins are forgiven and closeness to Allah is attained.

focus_5.title: Alhamdulillah (All Praise)
focus_5.translation: All praise is due to Allah.
focus_5.benefit: Fills the scale of good deeds.

focus_6.title: Allahu Akbar (Allah is the Greatest)
focus_6.benefit: Fills the space between the heavens and the earth.
